WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT Id, Reputation,
           NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY Reputation DESC) AS quartile
    FROM users
),
high_rep AS (
    SELECT Id FROM ranked WHERE quartile = 1
)
SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN u.Id IN (SELECT Id FROM high_rep) THEN p.Score END) - AVG(p.Score) AS score_contrib,
    AVG(CASE WHEN u.Id IN (SELECT Id FROM high_rep) THEN p.ViewCount END) - AVG(p.ViewCount) AS viewcount_contrib,
    AVG(CASE WHEN u.Id IN (SELECT Id FROM high_rep) THEN p.FavoriteCount END) - AVG(p.FavoriteCount) AS favcount_contrib,
    AVG(CASE WHEN u.Id IN (SELECT Id FROM high_rep) THEN b.badge_count END) - AVG(b.badge_count) AS badge_contrib,
    AVG(CASE WHEN u.Id IN (SELECT Id FROM high_rep) THEN u.UpVotes END) - AVG(u.UpVotes) AS upvotes_contrib,
    AVG(CASE WHEN u.Id IN (SELECT Id FROM high_rep) THEN u.DownVotes END) - AVG(u.DownVotes) AS downvotes_contrib
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT UserId, COUNT(*) AS badge_count
    FROM badges
    GROUP BY UserId
) b ON b.UserId = u.Id;

WITH user_stats AS (
  SELECT "users"."Id", "users"."DisplayName",
         COALESCE(SUM("posts"."Score"),0) AS total_post_score,
         COALESCE(COUNT("badges"."Id"),0) AS badge_count
  FROM "users"
  LEFT JOIN "posts" ON "posts"."OwnerUserId" = "users"."Id"
  LEFT JOIN "badges" ON "badges"."UserId" = "users"."Id"
  GROUP BY "users"."Id", "users"."DisplayName"
)
SELECT "DisplayName"
FROM user_stats
ORDER BY (total_post_score + badge_count) DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM users u
LEFT JOIN badges b

  AND u.CreationDate <= '2012-12-31'
GROUP BY u.DisplayName;
